FIELDS.NAME: Learn & Supply Co.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Learn & Supply Co. operates as a retail establishment focused on providing educational materials and school supplies to students, parents, and educators. Our inventory consists of stationery, art supplies, and various educational resources, all designed to support learning and creativity. We prioritize safety by ensuring all products intended for children comply with applicable safety standards. Our retail space, located in a commercial district, is designed with standard security measures such as locked display cases and adequate lighting to enhance safety for both customers and staff. We do not engage in equipment rentals or offer on-site classes, workshops, or food services, adhering to best practices to minimize liability and maintain a secure environment. With a commitment to customer satisfaction, we frequently assess our inventory and run seasonal promotions, especially during back-to-school and holiday periods. Our online sales are kept within 25% of total revenue to ensure robust cybersecurity measures are maintained. Staffed by knowledgeable sales associates and inventory managers, we are dedicated to creating a welcoming shopping experience for our community.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses occurred between January 10, 2023, and March 15, 2023, due to inventory theft and water damage from a burst pipe. The total amount of losses is $2,500.00. The status is resolved, with claims submitted to address the theft and water damage repairs completed.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Saturday: 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Standard security safe, Class B, rated for cash and documents.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station monitored alarm system with perimeter fencing and night security patrols.

FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The certificates are verified by our internal compliance team to ensure adequate coverage is in place.

FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – There have been no policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior three years. Our insurance history remains clear in this regard.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Learn & Supply Co. does not lease employees to or from other employers, focusing instead on our internal staff for operations.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Learn & Supply Co. carries Workers' Compensation insurance to ensure compliance with statutory requirements and protect our employees.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Learn & Supply Co. also owns and operates Online Education Resources LLC, which focuses on providing digital educational materials and resources.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Learn & Supply Co. does not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. We are currently maintaining our primary policy for retail operations.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Learn & Supply Co. is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products, as our operations focus exclusively on retailing educational materials and school supplies.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Learn & Supply Co. does not rent or loan equipment to others, adhering to best practices to minimize liability and property damage risks associated with rental operations.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – The applicant has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. Their financial history remains clear and stable.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Learn & Supply Co. does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as our operations focus solely on retailing educational materials and school supplies. We prioritize safety and adhere to best practices to minimize liability.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Learn & Supply Co. does not have any catastrophe exposure. Our operations focus on retailing educational materials and school supplies, with no involvement in activities that would typically lead to such exposure.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – There have been no past losses or claims related to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring at Learn & Supply Co. Our operations emphasize safety and compliance with all applicable standards.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Learn & Supply Co. does not have any uncorrected fire code violations, as we prioritize safety and compliance with all applicable fire codes. Our premises is regularly maintained to ensure adherence to safety standards.
